armbar.name: Rolling Arm Bar w/ Screwdriver Rotation
armbar.q: rolling arm bar screwdriver rotation shoulder mobility drill

tspine.name: Wall Side T Spine Opener
tspine.cue: Reach long, follow the hand with your eyes.
tspine.q: side lying wall thoracic spine opener rotation drill

shpullover.name: Shoulder Mobility Pullovers
shpullover.q: dumbbell shoulder mobility pullover ribs down

bandpa.name: Band Pull-Apart
bandpa.cue: Straight arms, low load, high reps.

banderer90.name: Band External Rotation @ 90 deg
banderer90.cue: Upper arm parallel to floor. No shrug.
banderer90.q: band external rotation at 90 degrees shoulder

banderir.name: Band ER / IR
banderir.cue: Elbow pinned. Rotate from the shoulder, not the wrist.
banderir.q: band internal external rotation shoulder warm up

wristsnap.name: Wrist Snaps into wall
wristsnap.q: wrist snap drill throwing into wall baseball

hipskip.name: Hip Mobility ER/IR Skips
hipskip.q: hip external internal rotation skip warm up drill

anklelift.name: Ankle Mobility Liftoff
anklelift.q: ankle mobility liftoff drill knee over toe

quadiso.name: Quad Tendon Isometric @ ~60 deg
quadiso.cue: 70% effort. BEFORE training, not after. ~45 min analgesic window.
quadiso.q: spanish squat isometric quad tendon 45 second hold

pogos.name: Pogos
pogos.cue: Stiff ankles, minimal knee bend, quiet.

cablerot.name: Cable Rotation / Rib Dissociation
cablerot.cue: Hips quiet. Rotate the ribcage on the pelvis.
cablerot.q: cable rib dissociation rotation hips quiet drill

mbsplit.name: MB Split Stance Toss into wall
mbsplit.cue: Load the back hip. Drive with hip rotation, not the arm.
mbsplit.q: split stance rotational medicine ball throw into wall

plyopush.name: Plyo Push-up
plyopush.cue: Hands leave the floor. Land soft.
plyopush.q: plyometric push up hands leave floor

plyoballrev.name: Plyo Ball Reverse Throw into wall
plyoballrev.cue: Controlled. This is the eccentric ER drill.

mbrepeat.name: Med Ball Repeat Toss
mbrepeat.q: medicine ball chest pass repeat toss wall

ripthrough.name: Band or Cable Rip Through
ripthrough.q: band rip through rotational power drill

mbshotput.name: Step-behind Rotational MB Shotput
mbshotput.cue: Build momentum. Land into a stiff front leg.
mbshotput.q: step behind rotational medicine ball shotput

mbscoop.name: MB Scoop Throw
mbscoop.q: medicine ball scoop toss rotational distance

mbvertunder.name: CM Vertical Underhand MB Throw
mbvertunder.cue: Priming only. Max intent, zero fatigue.
mbvertunder.q: countermovement vertical underhand medicine ball throw

penult.name: Lean/Fall Penultimate Jumps
penult.cue: Long low penultimate step, quick final step.
penult.q: penultimate step jump drill volleyball approach lean fall

boxrepeat.name: Box or Hurdle Repeat Jumps
boxrepeat.q: repeat box jumps hurdle hops minimal ground contact

altdrop.name: Altitude Drop Progressions
altdrop.cue: Step off. Land TALL, stiffer knees.

deepnocm.name: Deep Non Countermovement Assisted Jump
deepnocm.q: non countermovement squat jump no countermovement

slmultibox.name: Single Leg Multi Directional Box Jump
slmultibox.q: single leg multi directional box jump

approach.name: 4-Step Approach Jump
approach.cue: Arms back then up. Max downswing = final foot strike.
approach.q: volleyball 4 step approach jump technique arm swing

blocksim.name: Block Jump Simulation
blocksim.q: volleyball block jump repeat footwork drill

squatacc.name: Squat (Accelerative Strength)
squatacc.cue: Full depth. Move the bar fast.
squatacc.q: speed squat accelerative back squat bar speed

soleus.name: Soleus Raise
soleus.cue: BENT KNEE. This is the one sprints don't train.
soleus.q: seated calf raise bent knee soleus

spanish.name: Spanish Squat (~60 deg)
spanish.cue: Band behind the knees. Stay tall.

trapjump.name: Trap Bar Jump
trapjump.q: trap bar jump loaded jump squat

bench.name: Bench Press
bench.cue: Elbows tucked 45-60 deg, NEVER flared to 90. Scap retracted + depressed.
bench.q: barbell bench press elbow tuck scapula retract

latpulldown.name: Half Kneel Lat Pulldown
latpulldown.cue: Ribs down. Pull with the lat, not the bicep.

pullover.name: DB Pullover
pullover.cue: BENT ARM. Stop short of full end range.

stiffarmpd.name: Cable Stiff-Arm Pulldown
stiffarmpd.cue: Fallback for the pullover if pinching returns.

invrow.name: Inverted Row
invrow.cue: Body rigid. Chest to the bar.

serratus.name: Serratus Wall Slide
serratus.cue: Push INTO the wall. Reach long at the top.

pronepull.name: Prone Pull Through
pronepull.q: prone trap raise pull through shoulder

revthrow.name: Reverse Throws (plyo ball)
revthrow.cue: ALWAYS FIRST in the plyo ball routine.

pivotpick.name: Pivot Picks (plyo ball)
pivotpick.q: driveline pivot pickoff drill plyo ball

rollin.name: Roll-ins (plyo ball)
rollin.q: driveline roll in throw plyo ball

catchplay.name: Catch Play Build-up
catchplay.q: baseball catch play warm up routine

wball.name: Weighted Ball Throws
wball.cue: Week 5+. Never off a mound, never cold.

velotest.name: Velocity Test (video flight time)
velotest.q: measure pitch speed slow motion video frame count

towel.name: Towel Drill
towel.cue: No ball. Snap the towel through release. Full mechanics, zero space.

wristw.name: Wrist Weight Arm Action
wristw.cue: 1-2 lb wrist weight. Slow, full throwing arm path. No release.
wristw.q: wrist weight arm action driveline throwing

tubing.name: Shoulder Tubing / J-Band Series
tubing.cue: Full J-band series. This is the arm care backbone all winter.
tubing.q: jaeger j band shoulder tubing full series

wallrev.name: Reverse Throw into padded wall
wallrev.cue: 1.5-2 m from the wall. Controlled. Eccentric ER drill.
wallrev.q: driveline reverse throw plyo ball wall

wallpivot.name: Pivot Pick into padded wall
wallpivot.cue: 1.5-2 m. Torso rotation, arm along for the ride.

wallrocker.name: Rocker Throw into padded wall
wallrocker.cue: Rock back, rock forward, throw. Momentum into a stiff front leg.
wallrocker.q: driveline rocker drill plyo ball wall

wallwind.name: Walking Windup into padded wall
wallwind.cue: Last drill. Full sequence at controlled intent.

tennisrebound.name: Tennis Ball Wall Rebound
tennisrebound.cue: 1.5 m from wall. Continuous throw-and-catch. Fast hands, low load.
tennisrebound.q: tennis ball wall rebound reaction drill baseball

ribdis.name: Rib / Pelvis Dissociation Hold
ribdis.cue: Hips square, ribs rotate. This IS hip-shoulder separation.
ribdis.q: hip shoulder separation drill rib pelvis dissociation

items.note: Rotational throw for distance. Log your best.
